positioning.en: Python and TypeScript tools for inspectable AI and mathematical research: claims with evidence attached, negative results kept, boundaries stated.
positioning.zh: 用 Python 與 TypeScript 做可檢查的 AI 與數學研究工具：主張附上證據、負面結果留著、邊界說清楚。

facts.en: Mathematics Division, Dept. of Mathematics and Information Education, National Taipei University of Education · expected 2028
facts.zh: 國立臺北教育大學 數學暨資訊教育學系 數學組 · 預計 2028 年畢業

facts.en: Python · TypeScript · open to software and AI internships
facts.zh: Python · TypeScript · 尋找軟體與 AI 實習

about.en: I am a B.S. student in the Mathematics Division of the Department of Mathematics and Information Education at National Taipei University of Education, expected 2028, based in Taipei. I build small tools that make a claim checkable: a CI check that reads the test report instead of the exit code, an audit that ties a research claim to the bytes of its evidence, a search that returns the counterexample and the range it searched.
about.zh: 我是國立臺北教育大學數學暨資訊教育學系數學組的學士生，預計 2028 年畢業，住在台北。我做的是讓主張可以被檢查的小工具：讀測試報告而不是只看退出碼的 CI 檢查、把研究主張綁到證據位元組的稽核、回傳反例和它搜尋範圍的搜尋器。

learning.en: Currently learning Lean 4 and Mathlib through ProofWeave and the SAIR solver work, and reading about formal methods. I am looking for a software engineering or AI internship where tests and evidence decide what ships.
learning.zh: 目前透過 ProofWeave 與 SAIR 求解器的工作學 Lean 4 與 Mathlib，也在讀形式化方法。我在找一個由測試與證據決定什麼能出貨的軟體工程或 AI 實習。

body.en: I write the question, the boundary, and what would count as done: which tests, which replay, which hash.
body.zh: 我寫下問題、邊界，以及什麼才算完成：哪些測試、哪個重播、哪個雜湊。

body.en: Claude Code and Codex (including Codex Cloud) write most of the code, tests and docs, in branches I review. Most lines in these repositories were typed by an agent; every claim is mine.
body.zh: Claude Code 與 Codex（含 Codex Cloud）在我審閱的分支上寫大部分的程式、測試與文件。這些倉庫裡大多數的行是 agent 打出來的；每一個主張都由我負責。

body.en: Evidence decides, not confidence: tests, independent replay checkers, content hashes. Negative results stay published with the same care as positive ones.
body.zh: 由證據決定，不由信心決定：測試、獨立的重播檢查器、內容雜湊。負面結果和正面結果一樣，用同樣的標準留下來。

methodNote.en: This site and the GitHub profile README are generated from one catalog file; the build fails if they drift.
methodNote.zh: 這個網站與 GitHub 個人頁 README 由同一份目錄檔產生；兩者不一致時，建置會失敗。

filmsIntro.en: Three works from October 2026 where the film, the music and the cut are all source code. Each repository documents its pipeline and its limits.
filmsIntro.zh: 2026 年 10 月的三件作品：畫面、音樂與剪接全部是原始碼。每個倉庫都記錄了流程與限制。

negativesIntro.en: Results that did not go the way I hoped stay public, with the same frozen artifacts as the ones that did.
negativesIntro.zh: 沒有照期望走的結果也公開，和成功的結果一樣附上凍結的產物。

items.en: Shipped three works made entirely as code: ORACLE, The Disease Called AI, and world.execute(me).
items.zh: 發布三件全部以程式完成的作品：卜 ORACLE、病名為AI、world.execute(me)。

items.en: Froze the RuleDiff negative result as a technical report; the RuleShift-Web manuscript is pre-submission.
items.zh: 把 RuleDiff 的負面結果凍結成技術報告；RuleShift-Web 的論文仍在投稿前。

items.en: Two upstream fixes merged: DeepSeek Harness Desktop and dsh-engram.
items.zh: 兩個上游修正已合併：DeepSeek Harness Desktop 與 dsh-engram。

items.en: Learning Lean 4 / Mathlib through ProofWeave and SAIR.
items.zh: 透過 ProofWeave 與 SAIR 學 Lean 4 / Mathlib。

title.en: Normalise symlinked worktree paths so re-creating a worktree cannot misjudge and delete uncommitted changes.
title.zh: 規範化符號連結的 worktree 路徑，避免重建 worktree 時誤判並刪除未提交的修改。

title.en: Trace legacy database claims and add a conservative migration.
title.zh: 追溯舊資料庫的宣稱，加入保守的遷移。

title.en: Keep Windows verification failures distinguishable: narrower native-window fallback, standalone helper loading.
title.zh: 讓 Windows 驗證失敗可區分：縮小原生視窗的降級判斷，修正獨立執行時的輔助模組載入。

projects.name: HonestCI
projects.descZh: CLI 與 GitHub Action：檢查 JUnit 報告存在、新鮮，且測試數不低於可信基線。不判斷測試品質。
projects.descEn: CLI and GitHub Action that checks JUnit reports are present, fresh, and not below a trusted test-count baseline. It does not judge test quality.

projects.name: RigorGraph
projects.descZh: 本機優先的 Python CLI：把研究主張連到證據檔案與獨立審查記錄，檢查 SHA-256 雜湊，輸出離線稽核報告。VERIFIED 表示通過記錄的流程，不表示結論為真。
projects.descEn: Local-first Python CLI that links research claims to evidence files and independent review records, checks SHA-256 hashes, and writes offline audit reports. VERIFIED means accepted by the recorded workflow, not true.

projects.name: Verified Search
projects.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 檢索外掛：保留引用片段，讓證據缺口可見。只有 verified_search 是穩定版，四個擴充工具仍屬實驗。250 個測試；尚無獨立驗證。
projects.descEn: DeepSeek Harness search plugin that retains citation excerpts and keeps evidence gaps visible. Only verified_search is stable; four extensions are experimental. 250 tests; no independent validation.

projects.name: Second Agent Kit
projects.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 修補：shell 程序的 Seatbelt 限制、輸入呼叫上限、以專案為單位的記憶隔離。缺口都有記錄；它不是萬用防火牆。
projects.descEn: Patches for DeepSeek Harness on macOS: Seatbelt confinement for shell processes, input-call limits, and per-project memory isolation. Gaps are documented; it is not a universal firewall.

projects.name: DSH Architecture Lab
projects.descZh: 開發預覽：在 DeepSeek Harness 上跑隔離的記憶／規劃實驗（Lima VM 或 Seatbelt），附外部評判與費用計量。目前的結果只來自一個小型修復任務。85 個測試。
projects.descEn: Development-preview toolkit for isolated memory/planning experiments on DeepSeek Harness (Lima VM or Seatbelt), with external judging and cost metering. Results so far come from one small repair task. 85 tests.

projects.name: Finite Witness
projects.descZh: 在瀏覽器裡窮舉 6 個頂點以內的小圖找反例，輸出可由獨立 Python 腳本重播的憑證。通過有限搜尋是證據，不是證明。
projects.descEn: Browser tool that exhaustively searches small graphs (up to 6 vertices) for counterexamples and writes certificates an independent Python script replays. Surviving a bounded search is evidence, not proof.

projects.name: SAIR Proof Press
projects.descZh: 等式蘊涵求解器的公開伴隨站：輸出 Lean 檢查的證明或有限反模型。凍結產物在 1,669 / 1,669 個公開輸入上通過，最終執行沒有呼叫模型。
projects.descEn: Public companion to an equational-implication solver that outputs Lean-checked proofs or finite countermodels. Frozen artifacts accepted 1,669 / 1,669 released inputs with zero model calls.

projects.name: ProofWeave Core
projects.descZh: 把作者手寫的結構化 Markdown 證明交給固定版本的 Lean 4 / Mathlib 檢查，並把「已認證」與「人工確認語意對齊」分開回報。不做自然語言翻譯。
projects.descEn: Checks author-written structured Markdown proofs against pinned Lean 4 / Mathlib, and reports certification separately from human-confirmed statement alignment. No natural-language translation.

projects.name: RuleShift
projects.descZh: 確定性的本機測試床，看 agent 記憶策略如何面對規則改變。這次先導實驗裡，簡單檢索與較複雜的策略表現相當（153 / 160），成本更低。
projects.descEn: Deterministic local testbed for how agent memory strategies cope with changing rules. In this pilot, simple retrieval matched more complex strategies (153 / 160) at lower cost.

negative.en: Simple retrieval matched the more complex memory strategies; the complexity did not pay for itself.
negative.zh: 簡單檢索與較複雜的記憶策略表現相當；複雜度沒有換到成效。

projects.name: RuleShift-Web
projects.descZh: Web 政策記憶稽核工作台：3,200 次模型執行與 1,600 次對照。不用 LLM 的控制器比兩個模型都強。草稿論文，未經審查。
projects.descEn: Web-policy memory audit workbench: 3,200 model runs and 1,600 controls. The no-LLM controller was stronger than either model. Draft manuscript, not reviewed.

negative.en: The no-LLM controller beat both models on the frozen held-out matrix.
negative.zh: 在凍結的保留矩陣上，不用 LLM 的控制器勝過兩個模型。

projects.name: RuleDiff negative result
projects.descZh: 四頁技術報告：詞彙式政策影響預測器在開發集的 macro-F1 是 0.99，在一組保留資料上掉到 0.67。未經同儕審查。
projects.descEn: Four-page technical report: a lexical policy-impact predictor scored 0.99 macro-F1 on development data and 0.67 on one held-out packet. Not peer reviewed.

negative.en: 0.99 on development, 0.67 held out; the full-paper follow-up was stopped under its preregistered rule and frozen as this report.
negative.zh: 開發集 0.99、保留集 0.67；完整論文的後續依預先登錄的規則停止，凍結成這份報告。

projects.name: Charlie Alpha 4B
projects.descZh: 實驗性的 Qwen3.5-4B MLX 微調，在本機挑選統計程序。在模擬基準有改善（DGP-Regret −34%），在 P-Bench 與 StatQA 沒有。
projects.descEn: Experimental Qwen3.5-4B MLX fine-tune that picks statistical procedures locally. Improves on a simulator benchmark (DGP-Regret −34%) but not on P-Bench or StatQA.

negative.en: No improvement on P-Bench or StatQA; only the simulator benchmark moved.
negative.zh: P-Bench 與 StatQA 沒有改善；只有模擬基準有變化。

projects.name: TokenScope
projects.descZh: 雙語瀏覽器實驗室：手動設定的單頭 5×5 注意力玩具、取樣控制（temperature、top-k、top-p）、逐步 BPE 合併示範，數值可匯出。
projects.descEn: Bilingual in-browser lab: a hand-set one-head 5×5 attention toy, sampling controls (temperature, top-k, top-p), a step-by-step BPE merge demo, and exportable numbers.

projects.name: MiniHarness
projects.descZh: Python 工作坊：八步做出一個小型 agent harness，離線使用腳本化的模擬模型，附 38 個模組的繁體中文課程。不是生產環境用的。
projects.descEn: Python workshop where learners build a small agent harness in eight steps, offline with a scripted mock model, backed by a 38-module Traditional Chinese curriculum. Not production.

projects.name: 卜 ORACLE
projects.descZh: 4 分 30 秒短片：凌晨三點，有人問 AI「她會好起來嗎？」Three.js 在無頭 Chromium 裡只用 CPU 渲染，配樂與音效用 Python 合成。README 為片中的史料註明出處，並標示哪些是重建。
projects.descEn: A 4:30 short film: at 3 a.m. someone asks an AI "Will she get better?" Three.js rendered CPU-only in headless Chromium; score and sound design synthesised in Python. The README cites sources for the film's historical details and marks what was reconstructed.

projects.name: 病名為AI · The Disease Called AI
projects.descZh: 原創歌曲與手繪水彩 MV，3 分 35 秒，67 個鏡頭。樂譜是一支 Python 程式；DiffSinger 歌聲用固定種子逐位元重現；用 Whisper 聽寫檢查咬字。
projects.descEn: An original song and hand-painted watercolour music video, 3:35, 67 shots. The score is a Python program; DiffSinger vocals render bit-exactly from fixed seeds; Whisper transcription is used as a diction check.
projects.made: p5.js + p5.brush · DiffSinger · Kokoro · Whisper QA

projects.name: world.execute(me); · Claude Code
projects.descZh: 把 Mili 的 world.execute(me); 演成一場 Claude Code 會話，直接在終端機裡即時播放。純 Node、零依賴；每一格畫面都是歌曲時間的函數。非官方同人作品，承接 MisakaZentai 的 DeepSeek Harness 版；不含歌曲音檔。
projects.descEn: Mili's world.execute(me); staged as a Claude Code session and played live in the terminal. Pure Node, no dependencies; every frame is a function of song time. Unofficial fan work after MisakaZentai's DeepSeek Harness version; the song is not included.
projects.made: Node 20, zero dependencies · 24-bit ANSI · braille/sextant canvases

projects.name: DeepSeek Girl
projects.descZh: 同一份動畫圖集、兩個非官方宿主套件：Codex Desktop 的 16 方向動畫寵物，以及回應 Session 狀態的 DeepSeek Harness 外掛，離線運作。
projects.descEn: One animation atlas, two unofficial host packages: a 16-direction animated pet for Codex Desktop, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin that reacts to session state, offline.
